hero_sub: Ochre ramparts, authentic souks and palm oases: a relaxed town of the Souss valley.
overview: Taroudant is a walled town in the Souss valley, between the High Atlas and the Anti-Atlas. It can be visited in one or two days, on foot or by horse-drawn calèche, between ramparts, souks and lively squares.

tips.1: Start early: the streets are cooler and the souks calmer.
tips.2: Rent a calèche or a bike to go around the ramparts.
tips.3: Taroudant combines well with Agadir or Tiznit as a day trip.

q1.q: How long do you need in Taroudant?
q1.a: One day covers the essentials; two days let you add the Tiout oasis.

q2.q: How do you get there from Agadir?
q2.a: By shared taxi, bus or car; allow about an hour each way.

q3.q: When is the best time to go?
q3.a: Spring and autumn; summer is very hot.
